note: Hand-kept inputs the NHL API cannot supply. `returning` lists regulars NOT on the current roster (injured non-roster, LTIR, unsigned) who are expected back, with a birth date for the age curve; `out` lists rostered players missing games. `return` is the first league date the player is expected to dress ("season" = out for the year); games before it are removed from his projection. `prospects` gives a no-history rookie the ice time his role implies. `goalieShares` is the opening depth chart's share of starts; in season it drifts toward the starts actually made.
